source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.section: The Places and Degrees of Every Planet
source_locator.short_quote: The beginnings of the signs, and likewise those of the terms, are to be taken from the equinoctial and tropical points.

normalized_rule: Take the beginnings of the signs and the terms from the equinoctial and tropical points.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific zodiacal boundary convention within a traditional doctrine, not a modern astronomical coordinate claim.
review_notes: The source rejects unspecified imaginary planetary places and degrees; this rule records only its explicit equinoctial/tropical beginning convention.
transmission_notes: The boundary convention is explicit in the Ashmand/Proclus main text. No later sign-start or term-start system is substituted.
